qa.note: Aurora's letter of July 2, 2026 says it agreed to PJM's request to run the units until May 31, 2031 and withdrew its retirement notice. The June 30 cover letter said the agreement depends on PJM committing to keep the units running through the 2029 to 2030 and 2030 to 2031 delivery years with appropriate pay. So the extension was accepted, with conditions. The Illinois law deadline of January 1, 2030 is not a retirement date by itself.

monitor.monitor_reason: The retirement notice was withdrawn, but the units may still close by May 31, 2031 or after the state resource plan in 2028.
